rationale: PingPlotter's official Professional page documents network-route ping/traceroute monitoring, bottleneck/interference/hardware diagnosis, multi-target tracing, route summaries, alerts/REST API, standard latency/packet-loss/jitter/MOS metrics and reports. This is conventional diagnostic measurement and alerting, with no AI function identified in the substantive feature description. Product functions are sufficiently detailed for a supported negative label; absence of the word AI alone is not the basis.
version_scope: Current Professional product page matches PingPlotter Pro monitoring/troubleshooting identity; source record does not identify a release/version.

sources.excerpt: Graphical ping and traceroute monitoring. ... Identify bandwidth bottlenecks, wireless interference, or faulty hardware ... Trace as many as 250 targets ... Measure latency, packet loss, jitter, and MOS scores ... Shareable reports.
sources.applicability: Official Professional product page describes the same PingPlotter network monitoring and troubleshooting offering and its substantive measurement/alert/reporting functions.
